about_the_game:
Discover the early 20th century Paris in this intriguing game of love, crime and destiny!

The policeman's loud knocking on the door wakes you up. Your bellowed Sasha is no longer by your side. And while you have no idea what's happening, it seems like the police is very determined to bring you with them.

The twisted game of cat and mouse begins! Little will make sense, few will be ready to help you in finding the truth, but clues scattered around the city of Paris seem to lead to one particular place after all. Your determination to find your Sasha is the only thing that keeps you going! You know in your heart she's still alive!

In this thrilling hidden object puzzle adventure game, you will try to survive and find your missing love. You will have to find items, solve riddles and follow carefully, almost intentionally left clues in order to see Sasha again. But beware, the man with the ivory cane loves to play games with other people's lives. To him, the whole world is a theater! And everyone is puppets for his own amusement!

  • STEP into the role of a young artist caught up in a STRANGE CRIME

  • FOLLOW the bread-crumbs to save your love

  • INVESTIGATE Paris and dozens of locations

  • SEARCH for clues and FIND HIDDEN OBJECTS

  • DISCOVER the truth behind the chaos

  • SOLVE variety of riddles and MINI-GAMES

  • EARN achievements and COLLECT special items

  • DIFFICULTY MODES: novice, adventure, challenge and custom

  • BEAUTIFUL high-definition graphics and an absorbing story line
